# v6 read-compatibility fixtures

These `.osr` files (nine, one of them multi-block) were written by the legacy **Omega SREP 3.0.0** binary with
the v6 format. They are **data**, not code: the new OSREP decoder must read
them and reconstruct the inputs generated by `tests/golden/inputs.sh`.

`manifest.tsv` is:

```
sha256 <TAB> id <TAB> input <TAB> args
```

The archive is `<id>.osr`. The inputs are the same files `inputs.sh` produces
(`text.bin`, `empty.bin`, `tiny.bin`, `zeros.bin`, `zruns.bin`); the args are
the options the legacy binary used (v6 was the default, so they are just the
method/tuning flags). `text-b1mb-m3.osr` uses `-b1mb`, so its input is split into four blocks.

They are read-only compatibility fixtures. Do not regenerate them with a new
build; a new archive is a new golden case, not a replacement for these.
